name: kb_elemental_shaman
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's elemental list: Elemental Mastery before a fresh Flame Shock, Flame Shock kept up, Chain Lightning on cooldown, Lightning Bolt as the filler, Earthquake at two mobs and the shocks' instant cases. Molten Blast's refresh needs the debuff's remaining time, which a condition cannot see; the totems and the trinkets stay with the preset and combat_consumables.

rows.text: Searing Totem (Flametongue Totem in a melee group); other totems | before pull
Elemental Mastery / trinkets, then Flame Shock | target not fire-immune; Flame Shock snapshots [[d:shaman#1420830381762154628]]

entries.note: The KB's snapshot order: Elemental Mastery, then the fresh Flame Shock.

rows.text: Molten Blast | Flame Shock about to expire (~every 10-12 s); refreshes to full [[d:shaman#1482850420484210790]] [[d:shaman#1492517323838460035]]
rows.unexpressed: time left on an aura is not in the conditions

rows.text: Chain Lightning | Clearcasting up, or on cooldown when mana allows [[d:shaman#1484941909620428922]]

entries.note: The KB's 'on cooldown when mana allows'; the KB's Clearcasting case is the same cast, and the mana floor is the spell's own cost.
The filler waits for the player to stand still; Earth Shock covers the moving case.

rows.text: Earthquake | only with 2+ targets while bugged (DPS-neutral single target) [[d:shaman#1490703968576471180]]

entries.note: The KB's 'while bugged' note says its single-target damage is neutral: two mobs is its threshold here. Moved ahead of the Lightning Bolt filler, which would take every tick.

rows.text: Earth Shock | moving, interrupt, or target about to die; never as filler [[d:shaman#1459503774186999850]]

entries.note: The class_interrupt strategy owns the interrupt case (Earth Shock).
'Never as filler': it takes a moving player or a nearly dead mob, not the filler slot.
